notes.albums: Six albums: an uncaptioned opener (1), player version (1), retro (4), fan version (2), kids set (1) and half zip (1).
notes.newTeam: Ajax had NO products on the store before this batch.
notes.retroAlbum: The client's 'retro' album holds two ABN AMRO shirts, which are genuinely retro, and the two Bob Marley Three Little Birds thirds, which are 2021/22 and 2023/24. They are priced at the retro tier because that is the album the client put them in - flag it if they meant otherwise.
notes.seasonReading: Ziggo has sponsored Ajax since 2015 and ABN AMRO before it, which separates the retros cleanly. Within the Ziggo years the home is always red and white halves and the 2024/25 away was cream, so those date themselves; the light blue away and the black and gold third carry a colour instead.
